description: This file contains implementations related to test hooks within the Orleans Runtime system, including a mock environment statistics provider and a system target class for testing purposes. It provides functions for retrieving silo statuses, provider diagnostics, and storage or stream provider existence checks, used primarily for testing and diagnostics.

classes.name: TestHooksEnvironmentStatisticsProvider
classes.description: A mock implementation of IEnvironmentStatisticsProvider for testing, providing controllable environment statistics.

classes.name: TestHooksSystemTarget
classes.description: A SystemTarget implementation providing testing hooks for internal Orleans runtime diagnostics and operations, such as silo status, provider checks, and thread management.

methods.name: GetEnvironmentStatistics
methods.description: Returns current environment statistics, either cached or fetched from the real provider if invalid.

methods.name: LatchHardwareStatistics
methods.description: Sets the current environment statistics to provided data.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the system target; currently a no-op.

methods.name: GetConsistentRingPrimaryTargetSilo
methods.description: Retrieves the primary target silo address for a given key from the consistent ring provider.

methods.name: GetConsistentRingProviderDiagnosticInfo
methods.description: Returns diagnostic info from the consistent ring provider.

methods.name: GetServiceId
methods.description: Fetches the service identifier from the service provider's cluster options.

methods.name: HasStorageProvider
methods.description: Checks if a storage provider with the specified name exists.

methods.name: HasStreamProvider
methods.description: Checks if a stream provider with the specified name exists.

methods.name: UnregisterGrainForTesting
methods.description: Unregisters a grain for testing purposes and returns the result.

methods.name: GetApproximateSiloStatuses
methods.description: Returns an approximation of current silo statuses.
